title: oven-roasted german kiwifruit bake
description: a spicy, crunchy, and light german dish featuring kiwifruit and lardons. perfect for a buddhist temple breakfast or snack

ingredients.name: lardons
ingredients.notes: use a meat thermometer to ensure internal temperature is at least 160f (71c)

instructions: in a large bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon of apple cider vinegar, 1 teaspoon of ground cinnamon, and salt and pepper to taste.
add the lardons to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
arrange the lardons in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
in a separate bowl, whisk together 2 large eggs and 1 cup of heavy cream.
pour the egg mixture over the lardons and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
toss to coat the lardons evenly with the egg mixture.
transfer the lardons to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
remove the lardons from the oven and top with sliced kiwifruit.
return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the kiwifruit is tender and lightly caramelized.
remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
slice into squares and serve warm.
